description: Combat coefficients per ability GROUP. ADR-007: the key space is the ability GROUP, not the ability and not the school, because coefficients do not need a school and a weapon ability has none. abilities stays the identity and school table and joins on prefab_guid. THE REFERENCE CHAIN, one hop at a time and never a name join: group -> DynamicBuffer<ProjectM.AbilityGroupStartAbilitiesBuffer>.PrefabGUID -> the _Cast entity, which carries ProjectM.AbilityCastTimeData and ProjectM.AbilityCooldownData and ProjectM.GlobalCooldown -> DynamicBuffer<ProjectM.AbilitySpawnPrefabOnCast>.SpawnPrefab -> the _Hit entity, which carries DynamicBuffer<ProjectM.DealDamageOnGameplayEvent> whose element .Parameters is a ProjectM.DealDamageParameters. Cycle 2 MEASURED that chain: the cast hop resolves 1474 of 1474 groups, the damage hop reaches 562 of them, and a SECOND spawn hop adds exactly zero, so one hop is the whole answer. A group that reaches no damage prefab ships with every coefficient field OMITTED, never zero. Values are read with TYPED accessors: a generic value reader was built twice on this build and failed twice - managed reflection through EntityManagerDebug.GetComponentBoxed returned 539327184 for every Int32 and 1.402156E-19 for every Single, and raw il2cpp field offsets off that same pointer hard crashed the process. See docs/BRIDGE_SPIKES.md.

prefab_guid.description: PrefabGUID hash of the ability GROUP. The join key into abilities.prefab_guid and into items.ability_group_guids.

name.description: Prefab name of the ability group, from PrefabLookupMap.GetName.

is_weapon_ability.description: True when the group carries ProjectM.WeaponAbilityData, which is the COMPONENT that tells a weapon group from a spell group. MEASURED phase 1: weapon groups carry WeaponAbilityData and spell groups carry ProjectM.VBloodAbilityData plus ProjectM.AbilitySpellSchool. This is what dissolves ROADMAP cycle 3 gap 3 - a weapon ability needs no <Weapon>SpellSchoolAsset to be addressable.

ability_type.description: AbilityType enum member from WeaponAbilityData or VBloodAbilityData: Primary, Secondary, Travel, Dash, Power, Offensive, SpellSlot1, Defensive, SpellSlot2, Ultimate or None. OMITTED when neither component is present.

spell_school.description: AbilitySchool enum member from ProjectM.VBloodAbilityData: Blood, Unholy, Illusion, Frost, Chaos, Storm or Shadow. A SECOND and independent school source to the <School>SpellSchoolAsset join that fills abilities.school, and its enum carries Shadow, which the six-school join cannot produce. OMITTED when VBloodAbilityData is absent.

cast_time.description: ProjectM.AbilityCastTimeData.MaxCastTime._Value on the _Cast entity, in seconds. MaxCastTime is a ModifiableFloat, so the read goes through _Value the way UnitLevel.Level already does. OMITTED when the group reaches no cast entity.

post_cast_time.description: ProjectM.AbilityCastTimeData.PostCastTime on the _Cast entity, in seconds. The recovery window after the cast completes; a DPS denominator needs it alongside cast_time.

global_cooldown.description: ProjectM.GlobalCooldown.Value on the _Cast entity, in seconds. A plain Single, not a ModifiableFloat.

coefficient.description: ProjectM.DealDamageParameters.MainFactor from the FIRST element of the _Hit entity's DealDamageOnGameplayEvent buffer. The multiplier applied to the power stat.

raw_damage_value.description: DealDamageParameters.RawDamageValue: flat damage added independently of the power stat.

raw_damage_percent.description: DealDamageParameters.RawDamagePercent: damage as a fraction of a pool rather than of the power stat.

damage_type.description: DealDamageParameters.MainType, lowercased. Members are Physical, Spell, Fire, Holy, Silver, Garlic, RadialHoly, RadialGarlic, WeatherLightning and Corruption. NOT the spell school. OMITTED rather than defaulted, because Physical is the enum's zero value and so unreadable as evidence.

power_stat.description: Which power stat the coefficient multiplies. DECLARED AND NEVER EMITTED. PROVEN ABSENT in phase 1: no power-selector member exists across all 51 components enumerated on the _Hit entity, and MainType is the only discriminator present. Absent means unsourced, not physical. A consumer must not read damage_type as a power selector without evidence the combat-math spec has not yet produced.

hits_per_cast.description: LENGTH of the _Hit entity's DealDamageOnGameplayEvent buffer, which is how many damage events one reached hit prefab declares. This is a COUNT that was measured, not a model of the ability: an ability whose projectile hits several times gets that multiplicity from the three buffer lengths below, and turning those into an effective hits-per-cast is the combat-math spec's job, not this table's.

hit_triggers.description: LENGTH of DynamicBuffer<ProjectM.HitTrigger> on the _Hit entity. Phase 1 A6: multiplicity is buffer lengths, and this is one of the three counted here so a future derivation is checkable rather than asserted.

vblood_damage_modifier.description: DealDamageParameters.MaterialModifiers.VBlood, a Single. A per-target-CLASS multiplier: ProjectM.EntityTypeModifiers carries 23 of them (Human, Undead, Demon, Beast, PlayerVampire, VBlood, ShadowVBlood, the structure classes and so on) and VBlood is the one a boss time-to-kill multiplies by. NOT NAMED IN THE SPIKE SPEC's field list - found in phase 2 while reading the declared field types of DealDamageParameters, and emitted because a boss-damage table that omits the boss multiplier would be wrong in exactly the direction nobody would check. The other 22 modifiers are NOT ATTEMPTED: they are real and readable by the same hop, and no cycle 3 consumer reads them.

damage_modifier_per_hit.description: ProjectM.DealDamageOnGameplayEvent.DamageModifierPerHit on the first buffer element. Phase 1 A6 named it alongside MultiplyMainFactorWithStacks as the two fields that exist for repeated hits.
